owner: warp8f (observation source) / beamact5 (e2ewarp release ABI integration) / warp8f_memory (owner-side self-centric memory evidence)

contract.claim_rule: static_map mode: relocalized=true AND static_map_registered=true; memory mode (release_relocalization_memory_v1, default off): relocalized=true AND memory_registered=true with the navigator snapshot hash/revision, and no static-map field may be present (even false/null). The adapter never fabricates either claim.
contract.default_off_behavior: observe returns relocalized/static_map_registered false with explicit reason; command only holds (zero wheels) with approved pan PWM

memory_mode.binding: start() binds the navigator report memory_registration owner selfnav_memory_v1, memory_sha256, evidence_revision and destination kind
memory_mode.fail_closed: missing/not-ready/not-registered navigator -> no binding, no pan, no views, relocalized=false with the exact reason
memory_mode.owner_evidence: owner=warp8f, memory_registered=true, echoed memory_sha256 and revision, destination landmark of the bound kind, no map_pose/static-map field
memory_mode.owner_source: navigator memory_registration only (owner selfnav_memory_v1); no static map, global pose, GT or held-world read
memory_mode.echo_semantics: the navigator advances evidence_revision during the lookaround; the owner echoes the release-bound hash/revision and reports navigator_current_revision/navigator_current_memory_sha256 for audit, so the memory path does not stay permanently fail-closed
memory_mode.no_global_pose: pose_estimate is always self_centric (0,0); map_pose is null

allowed_inputs: existing SEARCH pan / max(settle_s)+0.1 dwell / +-500 PWM pan span constants (reused, no new tolerance)
forbidden_inputs: claimed owner evidence without static-map hash
static-map hash/registration or global map pose in memory mode (mixed evidence)
boundary_audit.import_scan: no sim.*, no scripts.e2e_warp_physics, no mujoco/warp import, no file reads; release imports limited to __future__/hashlib/json/math/harness.active_camera/harness.e2e_rgb_vo/harness.e2ewarp_selfnav/harness.grasp_act_contract/harness.warp8f_memory; owner imports limited to __future__/math/harness.e2ewarp_selfnav
owner_evidence_validation: memory mode: owner == warp8f, memory_registered is True, memory_sha256 and navigator_evidence_revision echo the bound navigator snapshot, destination landmark kind matches, no map_pose/static_map_registered/static_map_sha256 (key presence is mixed evidence), truth_inputs==0, held_world_reads==0

memory owner: live navigator registration must be valid, not behind the bound revision, hash-equal at the same revision, destination-registered with a matching landmark, and the landmark must not be from the future

tests.scope: Mac non-physical unit tests only; no GPU/physics run

owner_memory.scope: fake navigator snapshots; accepted echo, advanced-revision echo, stale/hash mismatch, wrong landmark kind, static-map field rejection
